acceptance.criterion: Declare owned snapshot and independently consumed operation records, historical inputs and external ownership
acceptance.evidence: Manifest declares snapshot and reference-report production, snapshot/report/map acceptance, six resolved schema definitions, and no upgrades. External HA payloads remain unstamped.

acceptance.criterion: Coordinate producers, rollback readers, validators and consumers with supported upgrade policy
acceptance.evidence: New snapshot and reference-report output uses v2 schemaVersion. Rollback and rename-map consumers validate current and legacy records. Saved artifacts are not mutated; no safe upgrades are required or declared.

acceptance.criterion: Exercise actual commands against controlled fixtures
acceptance.evidence: 26 real CLI invocations used a loopback Bun REST/WebSocket fixture service. Snapshot, validation, rollback planning and approved restoration passed.

acceptance.criterion: Preserve identity, registries, requested changes, rollback meaning, evidence and approval boundaries
acceptance.evidence: Fixture assertions checked registry/config payloads, original mapping keys, retained report hits, byte equality, declined approval, no dry-run mutation, exact restored entity and rollback log.

acceptance.criterion: Read-only and rejected unknown or unsafe inputs preserve bytes and remote state; historical records unchanged
acceptance.evidence: Unknown, mixed, null, malformed and wrong-family inputs rejected before fixture requests. Unsupported upgrade and overwrite attempts preserved bytes. Historical snapshot/map/report reads passed without rewriting.

notes.summary: First harness attempt used the wrong automation lookup key in its assertion. Corrected the fixture assertion to the existing entity-keyed snapshot layout; no product change.
Final harness passed all 26 CLI invocations. Fixture service stopped and throwaway script removed.
Configured TypeScript language server failed. No typecheck claim. Real CLI execution and scoped Bun tests passed.
Automatic bundle-version hook rejected removal of its own bump. Explicit HK_SKIP_STEPS=bundle-versions was then used to amend only the generated global version changes out of the source commit.
Final source commit contains only the 16 owned files; global bundle/plugin versions match the launch base.

limitations: No independent formal review in the implementation phase.
No saved-record conversion command: immutable historical inputs use readers instead.
